subject: english
title: Signal Words Review
objective: Identify words that show order, reason, contrast, or result in a text.
introduction: Milo is sorting clues in a short story! 🐱 Words such as first, because, but, and so show how ideas connect.

vocabulary.definition: A word that tells which event happens before another.
A word that introduces the reason something happens.
A word that shows two ideas are different.

activities.instruction: Watch how first, because, but, and so connect ideas.
activities.content: Signal words help readers understand how ideas connect: first shows order, because shows a reason, and so shows a result.

feedback.retry: Check the job of each word: order, reason, contrast, or result.

items.prompt: Mia is explaining how she made a snack. Which sentence shows order?

options.text: The cat sleeps by the window.
First, wash the mango.
The blue pencil is on the desk.
The chair is beside the door.

items.explanation: First tells the reader that washing the mango comes before the other steps.

items.prompt: Why did Ben carry an umbrella? Which sentence gives the reason?

options.text: Ben walked past the gate.
The bag is green.
Milo wears sandals.
Ben carried an umbrella because rain was falling.

items.explanation: Because introduces the reason Ben carried an umbrella: rain was falling.

items.prompt: Milo wanted to play outside, but it was raining. Which sentence shows the contrast?

options.text: The bell rings at noon.
The gate is painted blue.
Milo’s shoes are new.
Milo wanted to play, but it was raining.

items.explanation: But shows a contrast between Milo’s wish to play and the rainy weather.

items.prompt: The bell rang. Which sentence shows what happened as a result?

options.text: The mango is sweet and juicy.
The bell rang, so class began.
The chair is made of wood.
I walk to school.

items.explanation: So marks class beginning as the result of the bell ringing.

items.prompt: Which sentence links a reason to what happened?

options.text: The dog has a red collar.
The window is open.
It rained, so the plants grew.
My bag is heavy.

items.explanation: So connects the cause, rain, to the result, the plants growing.
